constraints.ocl:
context LibraryAccount
inv: (self.student <> null) and (self.isBlocked = false)

context Building
inv: self.rooms->any(x | x.capacity >= 10) <> null

context Course
inv: self.credits >= 40 and self.credits <= 49

context Scholarship
inv: if self.startYear < self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif >= 19

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 67 and self.capacity <= 96

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null implies self.endYear <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null implies self.endDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null
